items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I'm trying to remember, are you on the Louie Armstrong Plays W. C. Handy record, or Sach Plays Fats records? ... [INTERVIEWEE] I don't know, there's all different kind of tunes. God, I'm on so many of them.

ctx.x: Oh quite a bit. I did about two or three record dates there with Louie. Yeah, we did quite a bit of recording.
I'm trying to remember, are you on the Louie Armstrong Plays W. C. Handy record, or Sach Plays Fats records? I can't remember.
I don't know, there's all different kind of tunes. God, I'm on so many of them.
